entries.name: Agonizing Blast
entries.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

entries.name: Armor of Shadows
entries.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Ascendant Step
entries.description: You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries.description: You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Devouring Blade
entries.description: The Extra Attack of your Thirsting Blade invocation confers two extra attacks rather than one.

entries.name: Eldritch Mind
entries.description: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.

entries.name: Eldritch Smite
entries.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal extra Force damage and possibly knock the target Prone.

entries.name: Eldritch Spear
entries.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and has a range of 10+ feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

entries.name: Fiendish Vigor
entries.description: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don't roll the die for the Temporary Hit Points; you automatically get the highest number on the die.

entries.name: Gaze of Two Minds
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Gift of the Depths
entries.description: You can breathe underwater, gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and cast Water Breathing once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

entries.name: Gift of the Protectors
entries.description: Creatures named in your Book of Shadows drop to 1 Hit Point instead of 0 once per Long Rest.

entries.name: Investment of the Chain Master
entries.description: When you cast Find Familiar, you infuse the familiar with eldritch power.

entries.name: Lessons of the First Ones
entries.description: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.

entries.name: Lifedrinker
entries.description: Once per turn when you hit with your pact weapon, deal extra damage and optionally expend a Hit Point Die to heal.

entries.name: Mask of Many Faces
entries.description: You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Master of Myriad Forms
entries.description: You can cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Misty Visions
entries.description: You can cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: One with Shadows
entries.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Otherworldly Leap
entries.description: You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Pact of the Blade
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, conjure a pact weapon or bond with a magic weapon.

entries.name: Pact of the Chain
entries.description: You learn Find Familiar and can cast it as a Magic action without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Pact of the Tome
entries.description: Conjure a Book of Shadows containing three cantrips and two level 1 Ritual spells from any class list.

entries.name: Repelling Blast
entries.description: Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with that cantrip, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

entries.name: Thirsting Blade
entries.description: You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only.

entries.name: Visions of Distant Realms
entries.description: You can cast Arcane Eye without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Whispers of the Grave
entries.description: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Witch Sight
entries.description: You have Truesight with a range of 30 feet.
